title: Wisp marketplace MCP server
description: One MCP server in the Wisp marketplace: mcp/<id>/mcp.json. The folder name is the server's id.

description.description: One sentence on what it gives the agents.

kind.description: stdio: a local command; http: a streamable HTTP URL.

args.description: Its arguments (stdio). {input-id} is replaced with that input's value.

url.description: The server's URL (http). {input-id} is replaced with that input's value.

oauth.description: The user signs in with OAuth in the browser (http only).

oauth_client_name.description: The client name Wisp registers under when signing in, for servers that only allow known clients.

inputs.description: Plain (not secret) values the user enters when adding the server.

secrets.description: Env vars (stdio) or headers (http) whose values Wisp keeps in the system keychain.

name.description: The env var or header name.

prefix.description: Put before the value the user enters, e.g. "Bearer ".

optional.description: Left out when the user leaves it empty.
